## Reading notes for agents
- One line per physical click (mousedown/mouseup already collapsed — repeated clicks are fast clicking, not a double-click bug).
- Input text is masked by design; lengths are real, characters are not.
- Network lines come from the overlay's fetch/XHR hook: status, time to response headers (not full transfer) and a few response headers for every request (same-path successes collapse into one ×N line); a body excerpt (text types only, ≤2KB in the .json, marked when cut) only for failures. Cancelled requests (AbortController, StrictMode remounts) are listed but not counted as failures. Cross-origin responses expose only CORS-safelisted headers unless the server exposes more. Request bodies and credential headers are never recorded.
- This digest covers ONLY the 0s above. Anything the user did earlier aged out of the recording buffer.
- Raw events (rrweb format) sit in the .json next to this file if you need mutation-level detail.
